field_response: In all four prespecified closed-versus-exchange pairs, time-integrated target-local IFNG/TNF and CXCL fields decrease. IFNG and TNF are identical dimensionless fields here; their duplicate readouts do not identify independent contributions. IL2 changes have mixed signs, including within trajectories. Target-local averages sample the changing living-target population and are not fixed-cell exposure histories.
direction_normalization: For all seven cases, every living effector has a reconstructed gradient-direction norm at least 0.99 at every positive saved hour (672 case-hours). Nevertheless, the 96 h median local CXCL gradient in 2D changes from 0.00470795 to 3.97938e-9 per µm with exchange; in 3D it changes from 0.00223223 to 5.13249e-10 per µm. The normalized direction statistic saturates over this range and does not measure gradient strength, actual velocity, persistence or biological sensing.
onsets: All 20 pairwise first-positive saved-onset differences are zero. The four original pairs account for 16 of these, and the additional local-entry exchange-1 versus exchange-10 readout accounts for four. Hourly snapshots do not establish equal sub-hour arrival times.
matched_design: Within all five comparisons the cells and rules are byte-identical and the settings differ only in external bath exchange flow and output directory. This isolates a configured input intervention within each representation. It does not separate the downstream coupled field, population, movement and stochastic consequences. The central cross-representation comparison changes multiple conditions.
numerical_context: Existing numerical challenges retain substantial population, field and access flags; convergence is not accepted. The matched-medium outputs support finite model contrasts at their recorded discretization. They do not supply a continuum effect size or remove the need for the existing numerical conditions on claims.
scope: All cases have 1200 initial targets, 600 effectors, seed 0 and a 96 h horizon. One case per altered exchange condition does not establish stochastic robustness. The local-entry scenario is not a model validated for vessels, extravasation or in vivo response.
